options.RNGButton.farlands.tooltip: Removes the noise overflow fix that pushed the farlands out of vanilla bounds.
options.RNGOptions.gaussian.tooltip: Controls ?. If other RNG types are disabled, this must be enabled to prevent a crash.
options.RNGOptions.gaussianValue.tooltip: No info on bounds. Default value is 0.0.
options.RNGOptions.legacy.tooltip: Controls pretty much any aspect of world generation not controlled by Xoroshiro128++, like structures and loot tables. In this mod this also controls the unique seed generation function.
options.RNGOptions.legacySeed.tooltip: Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.mobFix.tooltip: Fixes a problem when disabling Legacy Random where mob UUIDs will not be random, causing them to fail spawning.
options.RNGOptions.singleThreaded.toolti: Controls particle spawning, stars, and other random elements mainly related to rendering.
options.RNGOptions.singleThreadedSeed.to: Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.threadSafeLegacySeed: Number output by Thread Safe Legacy
Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.title: RNG Options
options.RNGOptions.xoroshiro.tooltip: Controls most world generation, including caves and features.
options.RNGOptions.xoroshiroSeed.tooltip: With some certainty, must be larger than 2701463235000000000. 2300000000000000000 or lower will crash; between will lead to somewhat unpredictable issues. Some values higher will also crash; the exact criteria is unclear. Default value is the max.
